role: Player state actions the server must know: 1/2 sneak on/off, 3 stop sleeping, 4/5 sprint on/off, 6 riding jump.

members.name: field_149517_a (entity id)
members.note: not carried: client_out c0b[] stores bare action numbers, the target is always the player

members.name: field_149516_c (aux data)
members.note: only used by the riding action, which never happens in this game

members.name: C0BPacketEntityAction
members.note: sendMotionUpdates queues C0B_SPRINT_ON/OFF and C0B_SNEAK_ON/OFF from the tick's sprint/sneak flips

members.name: readPacketData
members.note: wire framing; the native engine has no network

members.name: processPacket
members.note: server_player_tick walks co->c0b[] in arrival order, flipping sneaking and sprinting (sp_set_sprinting) before the C03 is processed

members.name: func_149512_e
members.note: the horse jump power: processEntityAction reads it only for action 6 with an EntityHorse mount, and horses are switched off (world.conf horses = off)

members.name: C0BPacketEntityAction
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

missing: Actions 3 (stop sleeping) and 6 (riding jump) are not modelled: waking is driven by the act and bed flow, and nothing is rideable while world.conf has minecarts and boats off.
